reason: Behavior change alters term ordering/traversal logic in taxonomy field display (now iterates all taxonomy terms with full tree recursion instead of only selected ones), which fixes a bug but could subtly change output order or performance for taxonomies with deep/large hierarchies, though limited to display drivers and easily reviewable.
